sections.heading: CT University vs Gulzar Group of Institutes for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose CT University if you want a recorded fee of ₹90,000, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Ludhiana.
Choose Gulzar Group of Institutes if you want a recorded fee of ₹85,000, and an admission route through CAT, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Ludhiana.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹90,000 as a tuition figure for Post Graduate Diploma in Business Adminstration at CT University. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹85,000 as a tuition figure for MBA Finance at Gulzar Group of Institutes. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for CT University here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Gulzar Group of Institutes here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for CT University on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Gulzar Group of Institutes is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.

sections.heading: Location and campus

Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, CT University or Gulzar Group of Institutes?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. CT University and Gulzar Group of Institutes differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of MBA / PGDM classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for CT University vs Gulzar Group of Institutes?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹90,000 for CT University on Post Graduate Diploma in Business Adminstration; our records list ₹85,000 for Gulzar Group of Institutes on MBA Finance. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for CT University and Gulzar Group of Institutes?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for CT University here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do CT University and Gulzar Group of Institutes accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for CT University, and CAT for Gulzar Group of Institutes. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are CT University and Gulzar Group of Institutes in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Ludhiana, Punjab. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
